title: A/P aging shows a vendor invoice's new due date after its vendor changes
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a new term of the shop's own for this test, term A, due 14 days after the invoice date, so a vendor on it has vendor invoices due 14 days after their date.
  • Create vendor A for this test, on term A, so vendor invoice A below is due 14 days after its date.
  • Create vendor B for this test, on Net 30.
  • Create vendor invoice A for vendor A for this test, with the invoice date Oct 5, 2026, and leave it unpaid.
custom_steps:
1. Open the A/P Aging Detail report (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE).
  2. Open vendor invoice A in Parts, Vendors, Vendor Invoices.
  3. Change the vendor to vendor B.
  4. Save the vendor invoice.
  5. Open the A/P Aging Detail report again (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Vendor invoice A's row, under vendor A, shows the Due Date Oct 19, 2026 (Oct 5 + 14 days).

Step 2:

  • The vendor invoice shows the due date Oct 19, 2026.

Step 3:

  • The due date is recalculated to Nov 4, 2026 (Oct 5 + 30 days, Net 30).

Step 4:

  • The vendor invoice is saved with the due date Nov 4, 2026.

Step 5:

  • Vendor invoice A's row now shows vendor B and the Due Date Nov 4, 2026, the same as the vendor invoice (no longer Oct 19, 2026).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 5 (26 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11676 (Story 7, Due dates)

  • S7-R9: “A vendor invoice stores no term. Its due date is calculated by the same rules from the vendor's term when the vendor invoice is created, recalculated when its invoice date or its vendor changes, and stored. A/P aging shows that stored due date, so after a recalculation it shows the same new due date as the vendor invoice.”
  • S7-R1: “A Net term (standard or the shop's own) is due that many days after the invoice date: an invoice dated Oct 5 on Net 30 is due Nov 4; on a shop's "Net 10" it is due Oct 15.”
